# Fix-It Saturday, 13 March

**When:** Saturday 13 March 2027, 10:30am to 1pm.
**Where:** Millbrook Library, Room B (first floor, accessible by lift).
**Booking:** 40 places, book on the library's events page.
**Bring:** your broken item and its charger.
**We can't take:** microwaves, gas appliances or damaged batteries.
**Questions:** 555-0100.
